'''Ogress warriors''' are the moderate ranked fighters of the [[ogress]] society. They hit moderate damage and can be good summoning training to moderate level summoners (mainly drop gold).

Ogress Women were released along with the major graphical update to ogres and the Feldip Hills area.

==Drops==
{{DropLogProject|jagex=yes}}

The average ogress warrior with club kill is worth {{nocoins|{{GEP|Big bones}}+{{GEP|Ogre club|3/9}} round 0}} coins, and the average ogress warrior with spear kill is worth {{nocoins|{{GEP|Big bones}}+{{GEP|Tiny spiky iron salvage|3/9}} round 0}} coins.
